fixtures.transcript:
Tutor: Hey, how was your weekend?
Student: Pretty good. We went to the lake.
Tutor: Nice. Did you swim?
Student: Yeah, the water was freezing.
Tutor: Ha. How's your little brother doing?
Student: Annoying, but fine. My mom is getting me a snack.
Tutor: No rush. Tell me when you're ready to hop on.

Tutor: Can we move Thursday from 3 to 4:30?
Student: I have soccer at 4. What about Friday at 5?
Tutor: Friday at 5 works. I'll send your mom the new calendar invite.
Student: Should I still come next Tuesday?
Tutor: Yes, Tuesday stays at the usual time. If you'll be late, text me.
Tutor: Also the invoice for last month went out yesterday.

Tutor: Can you hear me okay?
Student: It's echoey. Hang on.
Tutor: Mute and unmute. Is your camera on?
Student: Now it is. I can see you.
Tutor: Your mic was on the wrong device. Click the arrow next to the mic and pick the headset.
Student: Okay, I think that's better.
Tutor: Loud and clear. Tell me if the screen share freezes.

Tutor: Today we're adding fractions. One half plus one fourth. What do you need first?
Student: A common denominator?
Tutor: Yes. Two fourths plus one fourth is three fourths.
Student: So one half plus one fourth is three fourths.
Tutor: Exactly. That's the answer.

Tutor: Let's find the main idea of this paragraph about whales. It says blue whales are the largest animals on Earth and they eat krill.
Student: The main idea is that blue whales are the biggest animals.
Tutor: Yes. The detail about krill supports that they're huge, but the main idea is their size.

Tutor: For homework, finish adding fractions: one half plus one fourth.
Student: That's three fourths.
Tutor: Yes. Also, can we move Thursday to 4:30? I'll send your mom the calendar invite.
Student: Friday at 5 is better.
Tutor: Friday at 5 works. Text me if you'll be late.
